exercises.title: A k-way merge
exercises.task: Each weather station's record is sorted by time. Write MergeAll: one timeline of every reading, in O(N log k) for N readings from k stations, with a heap holding the next reading of each station. The spec is in the file.
hints: The heap holds one cursor per station that still has readings: (station, index of its next reading). The top is the cursor whose reading has the smallest time; on a tie, the smaller station number.
Loop: pop the top cursor, append its reading, and if that station has more readings, push the cursor again with index+1 (or change it in place and call heap.Fix(h, 0)).
Two stations is the merge of 1.5.2; the heap only answers "which of the k heads is smallest?" in O(log k) instead of comparing all k.
